verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. God of gods, YHWH, speaks and calls the earth, from the rising of the sun to the going down.

segments.text: A Psalm of Asaph. God of gods, YHWH, speaks and calls the earth, from the rising of the sun to the going down.

verses.text: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

segments.text: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

verses.text: Our God comes and will not be silent; before His face a fire devours, and all around Him it will storm exceedingly.

segments.text: Our God comes and will not be silent; before His face a fire devours, and all around Him it will storm exceedingly.

verses.text: He calls to the heavens from above, and to the earth, for the judging of His people:

segments.text: He calls to the heavens from above, and to the earth, for the judging of His people:

verses.text: “Gather to Me My holy ones, those having cut a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

segments.text: “Gather to Me My holy ones, those having cut a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”

verses.text: And let the heavens declare His righteousness—for God Himself is Judge. Selah

segments.text: And let the heavens declare His righteousness—for God Himself is Judge. Selah

verses.text: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against you: I [am] God, your God.

segments.text: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against you: I [am] God, your God.

verses.text: [It is] not over your sacrifices [that] I rebuke you, or your burnt offerings before me continually.

segments.text: [It is] not over your sacrifices [that] I rebuke you, or your burnt offerings before me continually.

verses.text: I will not take a bull from your house [or] male goats from your folds.

segments.text: I will not take a bull from your house [or] male goats from your folds.

verses.text: For every living [thing] of the forest [is] unto Me, [and] the cattle on a thousand hills.

segments.text: For every living [thing] of the forest [is] unto Me, [and] the cattle on a thousand hills.

verses.text: I know every bird of the mountains, and the wild beast of the field [is] unto Me.

segments.text: I know every bird of the mountains, and the wild beast of the field [is] unto Me.

verses.text: If I were hungry, I would not say [it] to you, for the world and its fullness [is] to Me.

segments.text: If I were hungry, I would not say [it] to you, for the world and its fullness [is] to Me.

verses.text: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, and do I drink the blood of goats?

segments.text: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, and do I drink the blood of goats?

verses.text: Make a sacrifice of thanksgiving to God, and fulfill to the Most High your vows.

segments.text: Make a sacrifice of thanksgiving to God, and fulfill to the Most High your vows.

verses.text: And call on Me in the day of distress, [and] I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.”

segments.text: And call on Me in the day of distress, [and] I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.”

verses.text: And to the wicked God says, “What to you [is] to recount My statutes, and to lift up My covenant upon your mouth?

segments.text: And to the wicked God says, “What to you [is] to recount My statutes, and to lift up My covenant upon your mouth?

verses.text: And you have hated instruction, and cast My words behind you!

segments.text: And you have hated instruction, and cast My words behind you!

verses.text: If you see a thief, then you are pleased with him, and your portion [is] with those committing adultery.

segments.text: If you see a thief, then you are pleased with him, and your portion [is] with those committing adultery.

verses.text: With your mouth you send forth evil, and your tongue weaves deceit.

segments.text: With your mouth you send forth evil, and your tongue weaves deceit.

verses.text: You sit against your brother and speak; against the son of your mother you place fault.

segments.text: You sit against your brother and speak; against the son of your mother you place fault.

verses.text: These [things] you have done, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. I will rebuke you and set in array before your eyes.

segments.text: These [things] you have done, and I kept silent; you thought I was just like you. I will rebuke you and set in array before your eyes.

verses.text: Understand this, please, [you] forgetting God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and there is no one to deliver!

segments.text: Understand this, please, [you] forgetting God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and there is no one to deliver!

verses.text: The one making a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me, and he [who] sets [his] path, I will make to look on the salvation of God.”

segments.text: The one making a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me, and he [who] sets [his] path, I will make to look on the salvation of God.”
